title: Preservation Across a Deterministic Instruction
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input $x$, and configuration guard $G$. Suppose the instruction at live state $l$ is the deterministic instruction $i$, and the configuration with state $l$, register valuation $v$, and no answer satisfies $G$. If the configuration obtained by executing $i$ from there is terminating under $G$ and accepts exactly when proposition $P$ holds, then the original configuration has those same properties.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at state l is the deterministic instruction i
The successor configuration after executing i is terminating under G and accepts exactly when P holds
